Definition: Spinal cord weight in grams (printed row label 'Cord, gm'). The whole cord from the cut at the level of the upper root filaments of the first cervical nerve (where the brain was severed), removed from the vertebral canal beginning at the caudal end, leaving the dura, the spinal nerves (severed close to the cord) and all large blood vessels; kept in a moist chamber and weighed fresh in a weighing bottle on an analytical balance sensitive to 0.1 mg (MATERIAL AND METHODS, p. 515). Rows with measure = cord_weight; value in g, mass.mg in mg.
taxon: Oryctolagus cuniculus (rabbit, inbred race X; 50 males, 50 females)

Rows with measure = cord_length; value in mm.
